notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello Raiders,

What a month it's been! We've been absolutely blown away by the love and support for Arcane Raiders, we are truly grateful for all players!

We've been hard at work fixing bugs and improving the stability of the game. Patch notes are as follows:

 Fixed the bug preventing players from legally completing runs without taking damage
 Fixed the character skin unlock system
 Fixed the Dark Cow curse
 Fixed mouse inputs on various menu screens
 Fixed online glitch causing player names to be removed from the UI during runs
 General online stability improvements

If you find any more glitches and bugs, please let us know on our Discord server!

Thank you all for your continued support of Arcane Raiders!

notes.title: Arcane Raiders Releasing Feb 19!
notes.content:
Release Date and Price
Mark your calendars, arcane raiders comes out February 19th! On this day, the game will be released and will be available to play for free! We really hope you enjoy what we've made.

For everyone who's played the playtesting demo, thank you so much!!!, we've been able to put in so many great ideas and fix numerous bugs thanks to you! Some of the changes we've made since the demo are:

 Rebalanced almost all the spells to make sure they all feel powerful while also reducing the amount of down time spent waiting for spells to recharge
 Spells now automatically refresh when moving between rooms 
 Boss names are now colored for extra flair 
 The selected difficulty is displayed during the run under the timer 
 Hat effect text has been cleaned up to make it easier to understand
 The final boss sprites are now more distinct (they are also unlock-able!)
 You can pick different capes for your raider 
 Steam achievements are fully implemented 
 Fixed numerous bug in the online netcode 
 New art and sprites 
 Added a trailer and updated the screenshots for the store page
 Probably other stuff I've forgotten


see you in the tower soon!
- Tabby
